The checkpoint contains 534 C4 records, including 14 translational failures, 917 recorded provider attempts, and no C4R or C6 records; the live runner then terminated after four additional MAX_TOKENS attempts for row_id=20. amends.replacement_policy: Replace the failed Gemini 3.5 Flash replication cohort with stable Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite using thinking level low and maxOutputTokens 4096. Preserve all prompts, information conditions, budget definitions, row universe, parser, simulator, Oracle evaluators, quality gates, and multiplicity contracts. stopping_rule: Stop before the next newly generated live arm if any required payload archive, row-alignment, candidate-library version, or finite-arm compliance gate fails. Reused archives must satisfy the same arm requirements before entering the second amended grid. Do not reuse Gemini 3.5 rows under the Flash-Lite contract. Do not change prompts, thinking level, maxOutputTokens, or exclusions after observing Flash-Lite outcomes; issue a new amendment instead.
pooling_policy: Analyze each backend cohort separately. Cross-backend output is a replication table, not a pooled treatment estimate.

replacement_pilot_policy.pilot_pass_condition: The existing arm QC verifier must PASS without relaxed thresholds, including 1725 Stage7 rows, zero translational failures, and the frozen finite-arm raw-budget gates.
replacement_pilot_policy.completion_policy: A later full second-amended grid may reuse the successful Flash-Lite 0.75 pilot archive and the four frozen GPT-5.4-mini archives; remaining Flash-Lite arms are newly generated.
